zip.readme:
YT Batch Manager backup

videos.json   Video metadata. Edit any field, load this ZIP back with
              "Load from file", review the changes and press Save. A field you
              delete keeps its current value on YouTube.
thumbnails/   Each video's current thumbnail, named after its video id.

Replacing thumbnails: overwrite an image in thumbnails/ with a new JPEG or
PNG (up to 50 MB), keeping the video id as the file name. Only images that
change the picture are uploaded: one that looks the same as the current YouTube
thumbnail (e.g. your own original, or a re-saved copy) is skipped. Leave the
"thumbnail_sha256" values in videos.json as they are.

Custom thumbnails need a verified YouTube channel, and each thumbnail upload
uses about 50 units of the YouTube API's 10,000-unit daily quota.

notice.unsavedChangesFound: {count} video change(s) from {date} could not be saved because the API quota ran out.
notice.kept: The unsaved changes are kept in this browser: you can close this tab and restore them later.
